title: Cyber Shield X Metric Definitions
description: All metrics are defined mathematically and computed identically in Swift and TypeScript. Integer simulation ticks, not wall-clock time, drive the simulation. Rounding follows IEEE 754 round-half-to-even, applied after clamping.

generated_packets.description: Count of packets created by the scenario generator.

inspected_packets.description: Count of packets that entered INSPECTING.

held_packets.description: Count of packets currently in HOLDING_INTERCEPT.

escalated_incidents.description: Count of packets reaching ESCALATED (each creates one incident).

detection_events.description: Count of packets flagged as suspicious (score meets threshold).

simulation_throughput.description: Packets processed per tick: resolved_packets / elapsed_ticks.

simulated_inspection_latency.description: Ticks spent in INSPECTING before resolution. Average as round(sum / count, 4); 0 when count == 0.

queue_depth.description: Count of packets currently in INSPECTING or HOLDING_INTERCEPT.

threat_score.formula: score = min(100, sum of applicable rule weights)
threat_score.label: This is a simulation heuristic, not a probability of compromise.

detection_threshold.note: Packets scoring >= 40 at the inspection gate are flagged SUSPICIOUS and held for operator resolution.
